RESERVE_SCRIPT:
local t = redis.call('TIME')
local now = tonumber(t[1]) * 1000 + math.floor(tonumber(t[2]) / 1000)
local day = math.floor(now / 86400000)
local days = day
local year = 1970
while true do
  local leap = (year % 4 == 0 and (year % 100 ~= 0 or year % 400 == 0))
  local n = leap and 366 or 365
  if days < n then break end
  days = days - n
  year = year + 1
end
local months = {31,28,31,30,31,30,31,31,30,31,30,31}
if year % 4 == 0 and (year % 100 ~= 0 or year % 400 == 0) then months[2] = 29 end
local month = 1
while days >= months[month] do days = days - months[month]; month = month + 1 end
local period = year * 100 + month
local values = redis.call('HMGET', KEYS[1], 'version', 'enabled', 'day', 'month', 'day_used', 'month_used', 'day_cap', 'month_cap')
if values[1] ~= '1' or values[2] ~= '1' then return {0, 503, 60} end
for i = 3,8 do
  if not values[i] or not tonumber(values[i]) or tonumber(values[i]) < 0 or tonumber(values[i]) ~= math.floor(tonumber(values[i])) then return {0,503,60} end
end
local oldday = tonumber(values[3]); local oldmonth = tonumber(values[4])
if oldday > day or oldmonth > period then return {0,503,60} end
local dayused = oldday == day and tonumber(values[5]) or 0
local monthused = oldmonth == period and tonumber(values[6]) or 0
local daycap = tonumber(values[7]); local monthcap = tonumber(values[8])
local hold = tonumber(ARGV[2])
if not hold or hold ~= 5000000 or daycap > 20000000 or monthcap > 500000000 then return {0,503,60} end
if redis.call('EXISTS', KEYS[6]) == 1 then return {0,503,60} end
if dayused + hold > daycap or monthused + hold > monthcap then return {0,429,3600} end
redis.call('ZREMRANGEBYSCORE', KEYS[2], '-inf', now - 60000)
redis.call('ZREMRANGEBYSCORE', KEYS[3], '-inf', now)
redis.call('ZREMRANGEBYSCORE', KEYS[4], '-inf', now - 86400000)
redis.call('ZREMRANGEBYSCORE', KEYS[5], '-inf', now)
if redis.call('ZCARD', KEYS[2]) >= 30 or redis.call('ZCARD', KEYS[3]) >= 2 or redis.call('ZCARD', KEYS[5]) >= 1 then return {0,429,60} end
if redis.call('ZCOUNT', KEYS[4], now - 60000, '+inf') >= 5 or redis.call('ZCARD', KEYS[4]) >= 40 then return {0,429,60} end
redis.call('HSET', KEYS[1], 'day', day, 'month', period, 'day_used', dayused + hold, 'month_used', monthused + hold)
redis.call('HSET', KEYS[6], 'state', 'open', 'hold', hold, 'day', day, 'month', period, 'client', ARGV[3])
redis.call('EXPIRE', KEYS[6], 7776000)
redis.call('ZADD', KEYS[2], now, ARGV[1])
redis.call('EXPIRE', KEYS[2], 120)
redis.call('ZADD', KEYS[3], now + 60000, ARGV[1])
redis.call('EXPIRE', KEYS[3], 120)
redis.call('ZADD', KEYS[4], now, ARGV[1])
redis.call('EXPIRE', KEYS[4], 172800)
redis.call('ZADD', KEYS[5], now + 60000, ARGV[1])
redis.call('EXPIRE', KEYS[5], 120)
return {1,200,0}
SETTLE_SCRIPT:
local r = redis.call('HMGET', KEYS[4], 'state', 'hold', 'day', 'month', 'client')
if r[5] ~= ARGV[3] then return {0} end
if not r[1] then return {0} end
if r[1] ~= 'open' then return {1} end
local hold = tonumber(r[2]); local cost = tonumber(ARGV[2])
if not hold or not cost or cost ~= math.floor(cost) or cost < -1 then return {0} end
local ledger = redis.call('HMGET', KEYS[1], 'version', 'day', 'month', 'day_used', 'month_used')
if ledger[1] ~= '1' then return {0} end
for i = 2,5 do if not tonumber(ledger[i]) then return {0} end end
if cost > hold then redis.call('HSET', KEYS[1], 'enabled', '0'); return {0} end
if cost == -1 then
  redis.call('HSET', KEYS[4], 'state', 'unknown')
  return {1}
end
local refund = hold - cost
if ledger[2] == r[3] and tonumber(ledger[4]) < refund then return {0} end
if ledger[3] == r[4] and tonumber(ledger[5]) < refund then return {0} end
-- Mark first: a partial Redis/script failure must never make a refund repeatable.
redis.call('HSET', KEYS[4], 'state', 'complete', 'charged', cost)
if ledger[2] == r[3] then redis.call('HINCRBY', KEYS[1], 'day_used', -refund) end
if ledger[3] == r[4] then redis.call('HINCRBY', KEYS[1], 'month_used', -refund) end
redis.call('ZREM', KEYS[2], ARGV[1])
redis.call('ZREM', KEYS[3], ARGV[1])
return {1}
